message.content:
Based on my search, here is the information about the maximum unemployment benefits in Massachusetts:

## Maximum Weekly Benefit Amount

As of **October 5, 2025**, the maximum weekly unemployment benefit in Massachusetts is **$1,105 per week** for new claims. This increased from the previous maximum of $1,051.

## Additional Dependent Allowance

Massachusetts also provides an additional **$25 per dependent child per week**, up to a maximum of **$150 extra per week** for dependents. This means if you have the maximum number of dependents, your total weekly benefit could reach **$1,255 per week** ($1,105 base + $150 dependent allowance).

## Maximum Duration

Massachusetts offers one of the longest benefit durations in the country:
- **Up to 30 weeks** when the unemployment rate in any Massachusetts metropolitan area exceeds 5.1%
- **26 weeks** under normal conditions

## Total Maximum Payout

With the 30-week maximum duration and dependent allowances, the total maximum payout can reach approximately **$33,150** (30 weeks × $1,105) or higher with full dependent allowances.

Massachusetts has the highest maximum weekly unemployment benefit in the nation (tied with or slightly above Washington state, depending on whether dependent allowances are included), and also offers the longest standard duration of any state.
